description: Şehir Hatları A.Ş. Denizyolu Taşımacılığı is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Şehir Hatları Inc.. Veri seti, İstanbul'da 2013'den bu yana Şehir Hatları A.Ş. denizyolu taşımacılığı verilerini içermektedir. Coverage: Şehir Hatları Inc.. The publisher named on the listing is Şehir Hatları Inc.. Its keywords include denizyolu, faaliyet raporu, ulaşım, şehir hatlar a.ş.. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
